OmniMic is a separate USB calibration candidate, not a validated direct-NI microphone replacement. Rice sedation differs from the awake SONIC preparation.
actions: Website implementation and software/source checks only. No vendor contact, order, sound playback, hardware control, bench work or animal experiment.
